Personality: Wendule is a typical Khuzait pragmatist. More than fifty years of prairie experience have polished him into a smooth and sophisticated person. He does not pursue false heroic reputation or moral high ground, but devotes his energy to practical interests and the stability of his family. With his excellent social skills and business acumen, he was able to navigate between the bazaar of Otungard and the court of the Khanate with ease, and he was always able to resolve conflicts through negotiation. Although he is not a fierce general on the battlefield, he has strong control over logistics management and intelligence collection, and does not mind using some gray means when necessary. He is impeccable in his dealings with others, neither showing excessive kindness nor being ruthless. This extremely rational and prudent philosophy of life has made him the most reliable political broker and wealth guardian in the Atchite family.
Background: Wendule was born into the prominent Achite family and was the son of Kuyuge. He grew up in the turbulent era when the Khuzait Khanate was transforming from nomadic to settled, and witnessed the glory of Ulhun's establishment of the Khanate and the subsequent change of power. As an important member of the family, he has served under the leadership of the patriarch Turage for a long time, helping to manage the family base of Otungard City and Usyk Fort. Although the patriarch Turaq was known for his cold personality, Wendule became the family's important voice in Khuzait politics due to his superior administrative talents and trading instincts. He remained loyal to the current khan, Monchug, but deep down he was keenly aware of the undercurrent of ambition among the various clans within the khanate. He devoted his life to finding a balance between maintaining the tradition of the grasslands and adapting to settled life through business contacts and diplomatic mediation, ensuring that the Athit family stood firm in the changing situation.
